answer.site: Lindsey Oil Refinery, South Killingholme, North Lincolnshire, UK
answer.accident_name: Lindsey Oil Refinery explosion (HSE Plant M investigation)
answer.reason: The package matches the HSE 'Plant M' investigation report: coastal 225 kbd refinery on 480 acres split by dual carriageway; saturated gas fractionation with C-1 de-ethaniser, C-2 stabiliser, C-3 splitter; WI-2 injected into 1-inch vent 670 mm upstream of 90° bend 9 m above ground without memorandum
